subject: URGENT: SDK dechunker state corruption causing streaming failures for Helios Retail
messages:
From: Gabriel Torres <g.torres@heliosretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Helios Support <support@heliosretail.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High error rate & streaming stalls on checkout pipeline

Hi Olga,

We started seeing elevated error rates and multiple streaming stalls in the checkout recommendation service this morning after a Kubernetes rolling update. Latency jumped from ~120ms to 1.5s and ~15% of streams terminated with a parsing exception.

Attached is a small error dump and a short trace that shows repeated parser failures with a trailing-metadata parse error. We reproduced it hitting your SDK concurrently from 200 clients.

Can you please confirm whether anything changed on your side? This is impacting our peak traffic window. Appreciate urgency.

Attaching: helios_error_dump_20270823.log

Thanks,
Gabriel Torres
Head of Platform
Helios Retail

--

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High error rate & streaming stalls on checkout pipeline

On Mon, 23 Aug 2027 at 09:34, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Gabriel — thank you for the quick report and the logs...

Thanks for the logs, Gabriel — I pulled the dump and started a local repro using your parameters. Preliminary findings: we can reproduce the parser crash when the client SDK (sdk-client v0.9.7) sends back-to-back chunked frames where the chunk boundary coincides with a small trailing metadata block. The SDK dechunker state machine does not reset correctly in the receive path, which occasionally leaves a dangling state that causes the server-side streaming parser to see a malformed trailer and abort.

Steps I used to reproduce (attached): sdk-client-0.9.7-reproducer.txt
- 200 concurrent HTTP/1.1 chunked streams
- Variable token sequences; higher variance increases failure rate
- Observed ~12-18% parse aborts matching your numbers

Immediate mitigations I recommend:
1) Roll back Helios to sdk-client v0.9.6 if feasible (client-side quick mitigation).
2) On our side, I'll open a hotfix branch to introduce a defensive dechunker reset when trailer parsing fails and push a 0.9.7-patch. We can cut a patch release within 6 hours if we have prioritization.

I've created an internal ticket INF-7823 and will add logs and the reproducer.

Dylan
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: High error rate & streaming stalls on checkout pipeline

Folks — marking this P1 and escalating. Thanks Dylan for the quick repro. Two immediate asks:

1) Engineering: cut a hotfix branch and prepare a patch release (0.9.7.1) with the defensive reset. Work with QA on the reproducer and smoke tests. ETA expectation: 6-8 hours for a hotfix build + CI, 12-18 hours to get a staged rollout.

2) Customer & Sales: we need a single owner for customer comms and a proposal for a one-time credit for the impact window. Marissa/Sean, please propose language by EOD.

I'll also prepare an exec note for our CTO and Customer Ops. If we need to offer a rollback in our hosted routing for Helios' traffic, coordinate with infra and routing.

Rishi
VP Engineering
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Gabriel Torres <g.torres@heliosretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Update: action plan for streaming parser failures (Helios)

Hi Gabriel — sorry again for the disruption. Quick update and concrete next steps: 

What we found:
- Root cause: SDK client v0.9.7 dechunker state corruption when chunk boundaries align with a trailing metadata block, which can surface under high concurrency. Server-side parser sees malformed trailer metadata and aborts the stream.

What we're doing (timeline):
- Engineering (Dylan): cut 0.9.7.1 hotfix addressing dechunker reset. Hotfix build complete and smoke-tested in staging within 6 hours of triage.
- Rollout: We will stage the patch to a limited % of traffic tonight and, pending telemetry, expand to full rollout over 12–18 hours.
- Temporary mitigation: If you prefer we can route Helios traffic to fallback 0.9.6-compatible endpoints while you coordinate client-side change. Let me know which option you prefer.

Commercials / goodwill: Marissa and Sean will propose a credit for the impacted window — we expect a one-time credit proposal by EOD.

Requested from Helios:
- Confirm whether you want us to route to fallback endpoints (we can do immediate routing change) or proceed with staged patch rollout and confirm you will upgrade clients to 0.9.7.1 when available.

Attachments: patch notes will be shared to the Drive link once the release artifact is available.

Again, sincere apologies. We're committed to fixing this rapidly and will keep updates frequent.

Best,
Olga Petrov
